notInYourLanguage: Not yet available in your language

spaces.title: Documentation
spaces.subtitle: Policies, procedures and guides, organised in spaces and linked to the processes they describe.
spaces.deleteText: Only empty spaces can be deleted. Move or delete its pages first.
spaces.keyHint: 2–10 letters or digits, e.g. QM. Used in exports and cannot be changed later.
spaces.keyInvalid: Start with a letter; use 2–10 letters or digits
spaces.ownerHint: The owner can edit the space and manage who has access.

permissions.title: Access to {{name}}
permissions.info: These rules apply on top of the global roles: a person still needs the documentation permission of their role. Space owners and administrators always have full access.
permissions.restrictViewHint: Only the people, roles and departments listed below can see this space.
permissions.restrictEditHint: Only entries with “Can edit” may change pages.

pages.title: Title
pages.emptySpace: This space has no pages yet
pages.titleRequired: Enter a title in English or Arabic
pages.dragHint: Drag pages to re-order or nest them.
pages.noContent: This language version has no content yet.
pages.fallbackNotice: This page is not available in your language yet. Showing the {{language}} version.
pages.deleteText: The page moves to the trash of this space and can be restored from there.
pages.deleteWithChildren_one: The page and its sub-page move to the trash and can be restored from there.
pages.deleteWithChildren_other: The page and its {{count}} sub-pages move to the trash and can be restored from there.

editor.title: Edit page
editor.draftFound: You have an unsaved draft from {{time}}
editor.draftHint: Drafts are saved automatically while you type. Restore it to continue where you left off.
editor.draftOutdated: The draft was started from version {{draft}}; the page is now at version {{current}}. Restoring it replaces the newer content in the editor.
editor.saveHint: Saving creates version {{number}}. Describe what you changed.
editor.conflictHelp: Copy your changes, reload the page and apply them again. Your draft is kept.
editor.cancelText: Your draft will be deleted. The saved page stays as it is.
editor.linkHint: https://…, mailto:… or a ProcessHub path such as /processes/…. Leave empty to remove the link.
editor.invalidLink: Use an http(s) or mailto address, or a path starting with /
editor.diagramHint: The diagram is shown read-only and always reflects the current model. The process is linked to the page automatically.

diagram.unavailable: This diagram is not available (the process was deleted or you cannot access it).
diagram.noModel: This process has no model yet.
diagram.invalid: The diagram could not be displayed.

links.title: Related processes & objects
links.embeddedHint: Linked automatically because the page embeds this diagram

related.title: Related documentation
related.none: No documentation pages are linked yet

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.removeText: It disappears from this list. Older page versions that show it keep working.

export.printHint: Choose “Save as PDF” as the printer to download a PDF.

history.title: Version history
history.onlyOne: There is only one version so far.
history.restoreText: Its content becomes the new version {{next}}. No version is deleted.
history.restored: Version {{number}} restored as a new version
history.label: Label
history.labelHint: For example “v1.0 – approved by committee”. Leave empty to remove the label.

diff.identical: The content of both versions is identical in this language.

compare.title: Compare model versions
compare.latestVsDraft: Compare the latest version with the current draft
compare.syncHint: Panning and zooming is synchronised. Click a change to locate it.
compare.failed: The models could not be compared.

trash.title: Trash
trash.subtitle: Deleted pages of this space. Restoring a page also restores the sub-pages deleted with it.
trash.purgeText: The page, its versions and attachments are removed for good. This cannot be undone.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Bilingual starting points for new pages.
